interpretation: The overlap regression links libtest_cuda_common.la and reuses its severity counter and byte comparison. Its collective prerequisite checks and primary-context lifecycle remain specific to the overlap test.
The candidate runtime CUDA IPC source is byte-identical to cf3a1d0. Only test infrastructure and CI gating changed in this revision.
Fresh baseline and candidate release-mt builds use the same revised test sources. The baseline differs only in cuda_ipc_cache.c, restored from 74b413ab19d63c277ffa3fb553ed83e42bc50f6f.
The data-corruption control changes the last byte after a successful real cuMemcpy to the host buffer. The expected failure demonstrates that the shared helper compares the entire transfer.
The close-error control performs the real close successfully and then injects an error return. It verifies diagnostics rather than claiming an observed driver close failure.

Negative controls and explicit skips are expected outcomes, not successful GPU correctness runs. Normal baseline and candidate runs both pass byte comparisons; the baseline intentionally fails the no-import-error gate.

Allocator-dependent reuse remains an explicit skip condition. The standalone LRU gtest fixture does not exercise the production remote-cache import path; no deterministic GPU-independent coverage is claimed.
This is focused validation, not completion of the upstream CI pipeline, full static-build coverage, or application/performance acceptance.
build_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ucx_validation_root=$PWD
cd source
./autogen.sh > ../logs/autogen.log 2>&1
cd "$ucx_validation_root"
cp -a source source-baseline
cp baseline-cuda_ipc_cache.c source-baseline/src/uct/cuda/cuda_ipc/cuda_ipc_cache.c
build_variant() {
    local variant=$1 source_name=$2
    shift 2
    mkdir -p "build-$variant"
    cd "build-$variant"
    "../$source_name/contrib/configure-release-mt" --prefix="$ucx_validation_root/install/$variant" \
        --enable-assertions --without-go --without-java --without-rocm --with-mpi \
        --with-cuda=/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1 --with-gdrcopy=/usr \
        CC=/usr/bin/gcc CXX=/usr/bin/g++ CFLAGS='-O3 -g -march=znver3' "$@" \
        > "../logs/configure-$variant.log" 2>&1
    local link_flags="-Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucp/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/uct/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucs/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucm/.libs"
    make -j8 LDFLAGS="$link_flags" > "../logs/build-$variant.log" 2>&1
    make install LDFLAGS="$link_flags" > "../logs/install-$variant.log" 2>&1
    cd "$ucx_validation_root"
    printf '%s built and installed\n' "$variant"
}
build_variant candidate source --disable-static
build_variant baseline source-baseline --disable-static
cc -shared -fPIC -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include ipc_trace.c -ldl -pthread -o ipc_trace.so
mpicc -shared -fPIC -O2 -g -Iinstall/candidate/include -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include inject.c -ldl -o inject.so
mpicc -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include mpi_repro.c -L/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/lib64 -lcudart -o mpi_repro
python3 -B tests.py
python3 -B prepare-ci.py
python3 -B verify.py

attempt_notes.issue: The workspace is on a filesystem where chmod did not clear executable status; the non-executable-file control therefore invoked the test.
attempt_notes.resolution: Moved shell fixtures to a fresh POSIX temporary directory under /tmp. All 14 controls then passed. No production source change was needed.
